verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents the Storage Write API (gRPC) for streaming records into BigQuery in real time, with exactly-once delivery semantics. It also documents a Pub/Sub BigQuery subscription that loads data as it is generated, and continuous queries for analyzing incoming data in real time. missing for 10: an explicit documented seconds-level latency until streamed rows are queryable, and independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming freshness.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, streaming writes land queryable within seconds through a documented streaming ingestion API

citations.quote: Puedes usar la API de Storage Write para transmitir registros a BigQuery en tiempo real
The Storage Write API (gRPC) has lower pricing and more robust features, including exactly-once delivery semantics.
It supports real-time data streaming, loading data as it's generated.
Continuous queries let you analyze incoming data in BigQuery in real time.
